note: Honest two-door cut (26 Oct, v2): the proven banner flow first, the sketch and page flow as the extension, provenance on screen. One live capture: capture/full.mjs.

beats.text: Every campaign ships the same ad in a dozen shapes and languages, and someone rebuilds each one by hand.

beats.onScreen: Drop in a banner. Check what it found.
beats.text: I drop in a banner. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads its parts, and I drag the boxes it got wrong. Nothing it says is trusted until I confirm it.
beats.say: I drop in a banner. Nemotron three point five Super V L reads its parts, and I drag the boxes it got wrong. Nothing it says is trusted until I confirm it.

beats.text: A long German headline does not fit the story card. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one stops, renders both options for real, and Nemotron 3 Super words the question.
beats.say: A long German headline does not fit the story card. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one stops, renders both options for real, and Nemotron three Super words the question.

beats.text: I pick split, and an independent verifier re-measures the result. For my own banner there is no authored answer, and the app says so instead of counting one.

beats.onScreen: No banner yet? A sketch and your product page.
beats.text: No banner yet? Start from a sketch and your product page. This is a sample sketch we generated. Nemotron reads its boxes, and Tavily reads the page.

beats.onScreen: Facts from your page, with their quotes
beats.text: Nemotron 3 Super lifts the facts from the page, each with the quote it came from, and drafts headlines from those facts only. A headline with a number that is not on the page is thrown away, and every draft is for you to read and approve.
beats.say: Nemotron three Super lifts the facts from the page, each with the quote it came from, and drafts headlines from those facts only. A headline with a number that is not on the page is thrown away, and every draft is for you to read and approve.

beats.onScreen: Your own pictures, built as editable layers
beats.text: I add my own logo and product picture, and build. The banner is rebuilt as editable layers, and adapted to a story card.

beats.onScreen: Checked against your page. You approve the words.
beats.text: A page check looks for the price on the page. And this panel says where every part came from: the layout from the sketch, the words from the page, the pictures from me.

It also says what it cannot do: flat backgrounds, one font, sixteen by nine, and no generated pictures. On our test, sketch reading named every part but its boxes were loose, which is why you drag them.
The numbers, and the failures, are in the repository. Open Apprentice: bring a banner or a sketch, and see what was checked.
